viewers.col.name: Name
viewers.empty_former: Nobody recorded who is no longer subscribed.
viewers.empty_never: Not synced yet. That happens on its own shortly – or use “Sync now”.
viewers.error.too_long: Fetching took too long and was cancelled.
viewers.error.too_many: Too many pages – fetching was cancelled.
viewers.estimated_hint: Projected: the sub renewed without Twitch reporting it.
viewers.followers_live: The server syncs the followers with Twitch every ten seconds.
viewers.history_hint: When switched on, the plugin remembers who had a sub and since when they no longer do. That means keeping data about people who are not subscribed right now. Switching it on imports the sub endings already stored in the activities.
viewers.history_kept: There are still %{count} recorded former subscribers. They are hidden and come back when switched on.
viewers.history_off_hint: They then show up under Viewers → Subscribers with the “No longer subscribed” switch. Switching off hides them and records nothing new; what is already recorded stays.
viewers.lead: Who follows you and who is subscribed. The server syncs both lists with Twitch regularly; new follows and subs show up right away.
viewers.name: Viewers
viewers.perm.former: may see who is no longer subscribed (if enabled).
viewers.settings_lead: What the plugin keeps about your viewers.
viewers.sync_failed: The last sync with Twitch failed – the list may be out of date:
viewers.unfollows_hint: When switched on, the plugin keeps a list of who stopped following and since when. The unfollows themselves are in the activities anyway; this is about the searchable list. Switching it on imports the unfollows already stored there.
viewers.unfollows_kept: There are still %{count} recorded former followers. They are hidden and come back when switched on.
viewers.unfollows_off_hint: They then show up under Viewers → Followers with the “No longer following” switch. Whoever follows again drops off the list. Switching off hides them and records nothing new; what is already recorded stays.
viewers.unknown_hint: There is no event for this sub. The end date appears after the next renewal.
